title: Protection Against Sexual Harassment (POSH)
description: Employers are legally required to maintain a safe work environment and establish internal complaint mechanisms to address harassment claims.

title: Right to Equal Remuneration
description: Women are entitled to equal pay for equal work under employment laws, prohibiting wage discrimination based on gender.

title: Right to Protection from Domestic Violence
description: Individuals experiencing domestic abuse have the right to seek protection orders, residence rights, and emergency legal remedies.

title: Right to Free Legal Aid
description: Women facing legal proceedings or seeking justice are entitled to access free legal representation through public legal service authorities.

title: Right to Zero FIR & Safe Reporting
description: A Zero FIR can be filed at any police station regardless of territorial jurisdiction where the offense occurred.
